long_name: Wet Deposition Rate of NOy Including Aerosol Nitrate
description: Daily Wet Deposition Rate of NOy at surface. Vertically integrated throughout the column to the surface.
NOy is the sum of all simulated oxidized nitrogen species, out of NO, NO2, HNO3, HNO4, NO3aerosol, NO3(radical), N2O5, PAN, other organic nitrates.
